turns.text: Modified the recommendation of 800 to 240 units from Alquería. Over the 5-day horizon demand is 300 units (60/day) plus 120 of safety stock; 160 units are available and 120 are already inbound, so the own requirement is 140, raised to the supplier minimum of 240. The 800 was 233.33% above that and failed case pack, storage, budget and cover checks. With 240 the stock covers 5.67 days on arrival. The PO was submitted automatically for 1,008,000 COP.
